A <br> just after <a> is kept as a hard line break in the label

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("Beta<a href=\"https://example.com\"><br>Alpha</a>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
